# hestiacp_user (Resource)

Manages a HestiaCP user account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) User contact email address.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) User password.
- `username` (String) HestiaCP username.

### Optional

- `first_name` (String) User's first name.
- `package` (String) HestiaCP hosting package to assign. Defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (same as username).
